headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon, its newest AI model
summary: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier AI model, saying it delivers a significant leap in coding, agentic tasks and cybersecurity and tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index benchmark ahead of Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra. The model isn't available for public use yet. One outlet characterizes the upgrade more modestly, describing Carbon as only a slightly better version of its predecessor, Argon.
